ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a coward who stood and fought
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} stood when it counted, more than once, and has lost the habit of running.

plain.li: When the shooting started my legs wanted to run. I told them no, and they listened.
I used to know every hiding place in the colony. I've forgotten half of them.

warm.li: The others were counting on me. That turned out to matter more than being scared.

cheerful.li: Stood my ground in the last fight and only shook afterward. That still counts.

gloomy.li: Running never saved anyone here. Standing did, sometimes.

cold.li: Flight was an inefficient reflex. I've trained it out.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: vengeful after a vow left unpaid
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After the loss and a vow of vengeance left unpaid, {PAWN_nameDef} has started holding grudges, and is unhappy for as long as any of {PAWN_possessive} rivals is alive.

plain.li: I remember every one of them. Every face, every name. I'm keeping a list.
Someone said I should let it go. I smiled and didn't answer.

warm.li: I loved them. That's why I can't forgive the ones who took them.

cheerful.li: I'm cheerful about most things. Not about them. Them, I'll see to.

gloomy.li: The anger is all that's left of them that I can hold on to.

cold.li: Debts are meant to be settled. I intend to settle mine.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer vengeful once the vow is over
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: With the vow of vengeance over, {PAWN_nameDef} has let go of {PAWN_possessive} grudges, and having a rival no longer spoils {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: It's over. I thought I'd feel more than this, but mostly I'm tired, and I'm done keeping score.
I went through my list of everyone who ever wronged me today. Most of it doesn't matter anymore.

warm.li: I held on to the anger because it felt like holding on to them. I can remember them without it now.

blunt.li: It's done. I'm done with it.

cheerful.li: I slept the whole night for the first time in a long while. Not being angry all the time suits me better.

gloomy.li: Finishing it didn't bring anyone back. At least I can stop carrying it.

cold.li: That debt is closed. I see no reason to keep the smaller ones open.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer vengeful after a long calm

li.any: Kindness, ForgivenBy, NursedBack, SavedBy, SavedSomeone, PromiseKept, Married, BecameParent, RaisedChild, MovingRitual, TaughtWell, LongPeace

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After a long calm stretch with something good in it, {PAWN_nameDef} has let go of {PAWN_possessive} grudges, and having a rival no longer spoils {PAWN_possessive} mood.

plain.li: Someone got on my nerves today and I let it go. Last season I'd have held it against them for days.
I haven't added a name to my list in a long time. I don't think I'll start again.

warm.li: The people here kept being good to me while I was at my worst. I owe it to them to stop holding grudges.

blunt.li: I'm not angry all the time anymore. That's enough.

cheerful.li: Had an argument with someone and we were laughing about it by supper. I'd forgotten that could happen.

gloomy.li: The anger has worn off. I'm not sure what's left without it, but it's quieter.

cold.li: Keeping grudges took effort and gained me nothing. I've stopped.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: world weary after too many losses
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Too many years and too many hard seasons have worn {PAWN_nameDef} down. Bleak thoughts come easily to {PAWN_objective} now, and {PAWN_pronoun} is harder to get close to.

plain.li: Another season. The same work, the same worries. I'm tired in a way sleep doesn't fix.
Someone asked me what I hope for. I had to think about it, and I'm still thinking.

warm.li: I still care. I'm just tired of everything I care about being taken away.

blunt.li: I'm tired. Of all of it.

cheerful.li: I used to bounce back. These days I mostly just land.

gloomy.li: I've seen enough of this world for one life.

cold.li: I have stopped expecting the world to be worth the effort.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a rebel after the council let them down
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Broken promises and lost votes have taught {PAWN_nameDef} to take orders badly. These days {PAWN_pronoun} goes by {PAWN_possessive} own rules, and drags {PAWN_possessive} feet when pushed.

plain.li: The council says, and then I decide. That's the order of things now.
I heard the council out, every word. Then I did what I was going to do anyway.

warm.li: I'd do anything for the people here. Just don't call it an order.

blunt.li: They broke their word. I don't owe them mine.

cheerful.li: They can put me on whatever they like. I'll get to it gladly, in my own order.

gloomy.li: The council has promised me things before. I remember how that went.

cold.li: Authority here has proven unreliable. I'll defer to it only when it suits me.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a workaholic after seasons without rest
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A year with hardly a break, and fine work to show for it, has left {PAWN_nameDef} unable to put a job down, even when {PAWN_pronoun} should rest.

plain.li: They called me to supper three times. I finished what I was doing first. It needed finishing.
Went to bed and lay there going over the work, wishing it were morning.

warm.li: The work is how I look after everyone. Stopping feels like letting them down.

cheerful.li: Worked all day and there's still a list for tomorrow. Lovely.

gloomy.li: If I stop, I'll have to think. So I don't stop.

cold.li: Breaks are an inefficiency I no longer indulge.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: brave after holding the line and carrying someone to safety
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has held the line more than once and carried someone to safety in a fight. {PAWN_nameDef} is now harder to frighten and steadier when the fighting starts.

plain.li: When the raid came I went to the line without thinking about it.
I pulled someone out of the fighting last month. I'd do it again.

warm.li: If someone's hurt out there, I'll go and get them.

blunt.li: I don't run. I go where I'm needed.

cheerful.li: Scared? A bit. I went anyway, and it worked out.

gloomy.li: Someone has to stand at the front. It may as well be me.

cold.li: Fear is a warning. I've learned to note it and act anyway.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a perfectionist after a run of fine work

li.label: made a masterwork or a legendary piece

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: Three masterworks and a skill mastered in the last 180 days have raised {PAWN_nameDef}'s standards. {PAWN_nameDef} now cares a great deal about how well {PAWN_possessive} work turns out.

plain.li: I took a table apart today and made it again. The first one was fine, but fine isn't good enough for me anymore.
I checked every joint twice before I let anyone use it.

warm.li: Everyone here deserves things that are made properly. I won't hand over less.

blunt.li: If it isn't done right, it isn't done.

cheerful.li: Another piece came out exactly as I wanted. I could get used to that.

gloomy.li: Nothing I make is ever quite right. I keep trying anyway.

cold.li: Anything below my best is a waste of material.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a dog person after a year with their dog
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has been bonded to one of the colony's dogs for a year, and now likes having dogs around more than most people do.

plain.li: My dog follows me from one job to the next. I'd miss it if it didn't.
I saved the best scraps from supper for the dog again.

warm.li: A dog is good company. Mine has been with me through a lot this year.

cheerful.li: The dog met me at the door again today, wagging its tail the whole time.

gloomy.li: Some days the dog is the only one glad to see me.

cold.li: The dog is reliable and asks for little. I value that.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a cat person after a year with their cat
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has been bonded to one of the colony's cats for a year, and now likes having cats around more than most people do.

plain.li: The cat sleeps on my bed most nights now. I've stopped moving it.
I left a bit of fish out for the cat. It pretended not to notice.

warm.li: My cat has been with me a year now. I like the company.

blunt.li: Cats are better company than most people.

cheerful.li: The cat sat in my lap all evening. I didn't get anything done and didn't mind.

gloomy.li: The cat doesn't ask questions. That suits me.

cold.li: Cats are independent and clean. I approve.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: wanderlust after seasons away

li.label: a second season abroad within a year

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: After season after season away from the colony, {PAWN_nameDef} has come to like travelling, and gets restless if {PAWN_pronoun} stays at home too long.

plain.li: I keep looking at the road out of the colony.
I still think about the towns we passed through. I'd like to see more of them.

warm.li: I love it here, but there's a whole world out there I haven't seen yet.

blunt.li: I want to go somewhere. Anywhere.

cheerful.li: I've started a list of places to see next. It's getting long.

gloomy.li: The walls feel closer every day I stay.

cold.li: Staying in one place is starting to feel like a waste of time.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: desensitized after costly fights and many burials
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has been through two fights in which people of the colony died and has buried many bodies. Death and corpses no longer upset {PAWN_objective} as they used to.

plain.li: I dug another grave today and thought about supper while I did it.
I walked past the bodies after the fight and didn't look away.

warm.li: I still care about the people we lose. I just don't fall apart anymore.

cheerful.li: Someone has to bury the dead, and I can do it now without feeling sick. That's something.

gloomy.li: I've buried too many to feel each one.

cold.li: A corpse is a task. I handle it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: no longer desensitized after a long peace and some kindness
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: A long peace and the kindness of others have softened {PAWN_nameDef}. Death and corpses upset {PAWN_objective} again, as they do most people.

plain.li: Someone talked about the people we've lost and I had to leave the room. That hasn't happened in a long time.
I can't walk past the graves without stopping anymore.

warm.li: People have been kind to me. It has made me feel things again, the bad along with the good.

blunt.li: Death bothers me again. Probably for the best.

cheerful.li: It's been quiet for so long that I've remembered how to be soft.

gloomy.li: I feel the losses again. I'm not sure I wanted that back.

cold.li: My reactions to death have returned to normal. I'm not certain that's an improvement.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a mountain lover after a year under the rock
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent a year almost always under a roof, most of it under a mountain's rock, and now feels at home there.

plain.li: I like the quiet under the rock. You can't hear the wind in here.
I went outside for a while today and was glad to get back under the mountain.

warm.li: The mountain keeps all of us safe. I've grown fond of it.

blunt.li: Rock over my head. That's how I like it.

cheerful.li: Cool in summer, warm in winter, and nothing falls on you from the sky. The mountain is a fine home.

gloomy.li: Out under the sky I feel exposed. Under the rock I don't.

cold.li: Stone overhead is the safest roof there is.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a drunken master after fights won drunk
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef}, a brawler, has held the line three times while drunk, and now fights better up close after a drink.

plain.li: I had a drink before the fight and fought better than I ever have sober.
The others think I'm reckless. I just know a drink makes me loose and quick.

warm.li: If a drink helps me keep the others safe in a fight, I'll have one.

blunt.li: A drink, then the fight. Works for me.

cheerful.li: Three fights now with a drink in me, and three times I came out on top.

gloomy.li: I fight best when I'm drunk. I'm not proud of it.

cold.li: Alcohol improves my close fighting. I use it accordingly.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: a fisherman after a season at the water
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: {PAWN_nameDef} has spent many hours fishing lately, and has come to enjoy it and to be good at it.

plain.li: I spent the whole morning at the water and came back with a full basket.
I know which spots the fish like now, and when they bite.

warm.li: Fresh fish for supper again. I like bringing it home for everyone.

blunt.li: I fish. I'm good at it.

cheerful.li: The fish were biting all afternoon. Best day I've had in a while.

gloomy.li: It's quiet at the water. Nobody bothers me there.

cold.li: Fishing is a dependable source of food, and I'm efficient at it.

ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.label: craven no more after standing their ground
ColonyCouncil.TraitChangeDef.meaning: When the fighting came, {PAWN_nameDef} stayed, and then stayed again, and no longer bolts at the first sign of danger.

plain.li: When they came, I didn't run. I didn't even think about it until after.
My hands shook from start to finish. I stayed anyway.

warm.li: I couldn't leave them out there alone. Not again.

cheerful.li: I held my ground with the others. I keep telling myself it was really me.

gloomy.li: There's nowhere to run to anyway. Might as well stand.

cold.li: Running made me a liability. I've corrected that.
